# 90th Drama League Awards

| venue = The Ziegfeld Ballroom
}}
The 90th Drama League Awards were held on May 17, 2024, recognizing excellence in Broadway and Off-Broadway productions during the 2023–24 season. Nominations were announced on April 22, 2024, with Appropriate and Stereophonic leading the nominations, with four each. Both productions, alongside Merrily We Roll Along, won the most awards of the night, with two each.
Winners and nominees
The 2024-2025 Drama League Awards nominations were announced on Monday, April 22, 2024, by Vanessa Williams and Bebe Neuwirth. The awards ceremony took place on Friday, May 17, 2024, at the The Ziegfeld Ballroom, hosted by journalist Frank DiLella. Special awards recipients included:
*Jessica Lange - Contribution to the Theatre Award
*Jonathan Groff - Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theatre
*Schele Williams -  Founders Award for Excellence in Directing
*Kandi Burruss - Gratitude Award
Winners included Stereophonic, which received Outstanding Production of a Play and Outstanding Direction of a Play for Daniel Aukin; Appropriate, which won Outstanding Revival of a Play and Distinguished Performance for Sarah Paulson; Merrily We Roll Along, which received Outstanding Revival of a Musical and Outstanding Direction of a Musical for Maria Friedman. Additionally, ''Hell's Kitchen won the award for Outstanding Production of a Musical. Special awards recipients included:
